hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(process.platform!=='win32'&&/(npm run dev\b|pnpm( run)? dev\b|yarn dev\b|bun run dev\b)/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server should run in tmux for log access');console.error('[Hook] Use: tmux new-session -d -s dev \"npm run dev\"');console.error('[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev');process.exit(2)}}catch{}console.log(d)})"

PreToolUse.description: Block dev servers outside tmux so logs remain accessible

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(process.platform!=='win32'&&!process.env.TMUX&&/(npm (install|test)|pnpm (install|test)|yarn (install|test)?|bun (install|test)|cargo build|make\b|docker\b|pytest|vitest|playwright|pdm run)/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] Consider running long-lived commands in tmux for persistence');console.error('[Hook] tmux new -s dev  |  tmux attach -t dev')}}catch{}console.log(d)})"

PreToolUse.description: Remind when long-running commands are started outside tmux

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/git push/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] Review changes before push')}}catch{}console.log(d)})"

node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/gh pr create/.test(cmd)){const out=i.tool_output?.output||'';const m=out.match(/https:\/\/github.com\/[^/]+\/[^/]+\/pull\/\d+/);if(m){console.error('[Hook] PR created: '+m[0])}}}catch{}console.log(d)})"

PostToolUse.description: Echo created PR URL after gh pr create
